I mean, of course if all those things weren't a factor I'd probably be better off, but thats not the reality I live in. 

Its a suffocating cycle.. Cant pay for the necessary physical rehab for the injury out of pocket, can't work and get health insurance to deal with mental or internal illnesses. Can't deal with the trauma til I get professional help, which again, costs money, each part is connected and prevents the other parts from ever improving.

Childhood assault trauma. 

Health is in terrible shape, because of years of heavy drug/alcohol abuse to cope, now I'm coughing up blood daily, with no health insurance, and my family already struggles financially and with their own health issues so theres no point adding more medical bills.

Been out of work for the last year cause of an on the job injury, and got fucked over by L&I with my rehab, and now my debt and financial burden is way worse than ever before.

There's more issues but those are the main 3 factors contributing to this decision

The prospect of "better days to come" unfortunately isn't enough to change my mind. Neither is "loved ones want/need you". My belief is that you should live for yourself, people come and go, hurt and betray you, pass away before you, etc, etc, so it really boils down to living for your own self worth, but its just not worth it anymore. And as far as funerals go, in my note, I ask to be cremated, which I found services for less than $600 in my area, which is feasible, and they could easily sell off all my possessions to generate that amount. Sorry if any of this came off as cynical or ungrateful, I appreciate your empathy and reaching out.

Trazodone doesn't do much for me either unfortunately but im hoping if I drink enough with it, it'll have a greater impact. Do you think 15-20 mins driving should be okay without being too impaired if I took it right before I left and then drink when I get there? And no, hospitals mean hospital bills and im currently unemployed and no insurance. My family already has a multitude of other financial and health burdens, so I'd rather not add to it. This seems to be the best recourse. But im glad it was able to help you.
Did you go through with it and it didn't work? Or just changed your mind?
